svg.title: Completion report
svg.desc: Fictional completion report for password-link, in the shape of ha report output. Five summary lines: Changed, Checked, To review, Remaining limits (assurance local; check author: executor) and Next step. Then the evidence per condition under completion record seq 6: AC-1 change with records 2, 3 and AC-2 maintain with record 4. A fictional example, not a real record.
